page.layout: One page of text, one column. Running head and page number at the top. Below the running head, an italic dedication heading to Petrus a Valle, then a greeting line, then the body text in one column. No marginal notes.

head.i: Nobilissimo & Perillustri viro Petro à Valle

main_text.p: MEnses aliquot jam elapsi sunt, cùm R. Pater Bertinus Alphabetum Ægy-ptiacum ad me misit, quod delineaveras; donum mihi fuit gratissimum & exoptatissimum, gratias habui tibi, atqve nunc habeo maximas, utinam referre possem, divitias enim multas rebus ejusmodi, quæ ad sacræ scripturæ cognitionem conducunt, longe postpono: ab eo tempore huc usque huic studio mihi va-care non licuit, nunc cum licet, benefi-cii accepti gratias ago, & simul impor-tunus esse tibi cogor, sed importunitate-m meam ab humanitate tua supera-tum iri confido; sunt in Bibliotheca no-stra quatuor Evangelia Lingua Coptica eleganter atq: ab antiquo descripta, quæ R. Pater de Sancy Constantinopoli Lutetiam attulit. Græcus est character, propter literas tamen additicias paucissimas voces perfectæ legere poteram. Sed Alphabeti tui ope adjutus nihil amplius me à literarum cognitione & syllabarum com-

page.notes: Large woodcut initial M joined to "Enses" as "MEnses". Italic dedication heading and greeting line as printed. Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Printed "atq:" kept as printed. Line-end hyphens retained. The last line of the page ends with "com-", which I kept as printed. The heading "Nobilissimo" is partly obscured at the left edge, but the reading is clear.
